messages:
Maya: Good morning! I left some waffles in the kitchen, tagged them `release_candidate-0.1` so people would be gentle. :wave:
Luis: Nice. I once published a toaster as `0.0.1-alpha+exp.sha.5114f85` and it only accepted YAML configs.
Rina: The YAML it expects is extremely opinionated. Example from the logs:
```yaml
toast:
  level: medium
  butter: 'optional
  notes: >
    If butter: true then toast.taste++
```
Maya: That missing quote makes the toaster whisper 'unexpected end of input' like my compiler when I forget a semicolon. :sweat_smile:
dev-bot: FYI kitchen-ci: breakfast-tests failed on syrup-compatibility. See /ci/kitchen/1723 for details. :robot_face:
Luis: Metadata question: do we semver condiments? Asking for a friend who bumped ketchup to v3 because of API changes.
Rina: I propose the "no breaking syrup" policy. Any syrup bump that disagrees with pancakes requires a migration script in `scripts/migrate_syrup.sh`.
Maya: Migration script sample: `sed -i 's/maple/ambiguous-syrup/g' pancakes.yaml`  (works on macos?)
Luis: Also, please don't push `latest` tag for coffee. Last time we had two different roast flavors deployed to main. :coffee:
Maya: Two-line poll: React with :maple_leaf: for maple purist, :syringe: for experimental syrups. I'll tally at lunch.
Rina: Bonus meme sticker on the fridge: "My code compiles, my breakfast runs." :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Luis: If anyone's brave enough to write release notes for brunch: please include a compatibility table and an example of "how to rollback to butter-legacy".
Maya: tagging @kitchen-ops because the waffle stack crashed once when someone set batter.retries: -1. We still don't know how that worked.
dev-bot: kitchen-ops notified. Ticket #BRKFST-209 created.
Rina: OK lunch poll closes in 3h. May your parsers be forgiving.
